subject: Forecast stability check: BrightByte account — action items
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@brightbyte.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Forecast stability check: BrightByte account — action items

Hi Sarah / Amanda —

Quick pulse from our side as we prep internal finances for December close. A couple of items we need confirmed to lock the forecast: 

1) Usage/Consumption: I attached a short export (BrightByte_Q3_usage.csv) showing token and embedding volumes vs. the committed baseline. Can you confirm whether the Q4 projection in the second tab reflects the team’s current plan (especially the new Synapse feature rollout)?

2) Renewal posture and stage accuracy in HubSpot: HubSpot shows the deal at "Commit" but our CRO motion is flagging it as "Pending FinOps". Please confirm who will own the signature once procurement finishes (name + role). This matters for who we list as the responsible owner for the finance forecast.

3) Timing / procurement milestones: any updated PO timelines or additional approval steps on your side we should factor into the cash recognition schedule?

Ask: Can you reply with a one-line confirmation for each of the three items by end of day Wednesday? If helpful, we can do a 30-min call Thurs to align.

Attachments: BrightByte_Q3_usage.csv (consumption export)

Thanks —
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@brightbyte.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Li <amanda.li@brightbyte.com>, BrightByte Finance <finance@brightbyte.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Forecast stability check: BrightByte account — action items

Lukas —

Thanks for the clear note and the usage export. Quick answers inline: 

1) Usage/Consumption: Yes — the Q4 projection is our internal plan but it assumes Synapse launches in early December. We expect an initial 12–15% uplift in token volume once the feature is enabled. I attached the latest SOW draft the procurement team circulated (SOW_BrightByte_v3_draft.pdf).

2) Renewal posture & owner: Procurement will sign off, and Amanda Li (cc’d) is the PO owner. Amanda will be the signee on the contract.

3) Timing / procurement: We’re targeting a signed PO by 11/30 but BrightByte Finance indicated they may need one extra week for vendor onboarding checks — so the contingency is 12/7.

We can do a 30-min alignment Thurs at 10am PT if that works for your team.

Sarah Chen
Director, Product Operations | BrightByte Inc.
sarah.chen@brightbyte.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@brightbyte.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T08:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Forecast stability check: BrightByte account — action items

Thanks Sarah — that helps. Internal notes and proposed adjustments: 

- Stage & risk: Update HubSpot to set Stage = "Pending FinOps" with Probability = 70% (was 85%). Rationale: procurement signee is confirmed but finance approvals add 1–2 weeks risk.
- ARR impact: Based on the Q4 usage uplift, we model an incremental $42k ARR uplift spread across Feb–Apr next year; I’ve put the numbers in the mutual action plan (MAP_BrightByte_20271108.xlsx).
- Cash recognition timing: For finance, treat the expected recognition as 12/2027 if PO and onboarding complete by 12/7; otherwise push to 01/2028.

Action items: 
- Lukas: please update HubSpot deal RWI-2027-BB-0421 with the new stage/probability and attach the MAP.
- Sarah/Amanda: confirm PO submission date once the draft SOW is finalized — Naomi will coordinate the commitment checkbox for FinOps.

If everyone is aligned here, can we run the short call Thurs 11/10 at 10:00am PT to close outstanding items? I’ll prepare a 10-min runbook for finance and signature steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Renewals & Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@brightbyte.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Forecast stability check: BrightByte account — action items

Perfect — thanks all for the quick turn. Confirming next steps and owners before the Thurs call: 

- HubSpot updates: I updated deal RWI-2027-BB-0421 to Stage = "Pending FinOps", Probability = 70%, attached the MAP.
- Meeting: Confirmed Thurs 11/10 10:00am PT (Calendar invite sent).
- Procurement timeline: Sarah/Amanda to share final PO date during the call; Naomi to confirm if FinOps approval will require any additional documentation beyond the SOW.
- Doc signing: Once PO is in place we will route the SOW for signature via DocuSign. I’ve attached a doclink in the HubSpot record.

Forwarding the latest materials below for quick reference. If anything changes this morning, flag it in the thread and we’ll update the forecast immediately.

Regards,
Lukas
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
